mapper.select: select t.*, u.name as leader_name, u.avatar as leader_avatar, a.title as activity_name, teacher.name as teacher_name, (select count(*) from team_member where team_id = t.id) as member_count from `team` t left join `user` u on t.leader_id = u.id left join `activity` a on t.activity_id = a.id left join `user` teacher on t.teacher_id = teacher.id where t.id = #{id}
